answer: A zenith-marked harbor watchtower bond keeps fakes out. First, each newcomer stakes 200 POA for a watchtower berth tied to one hardware key. Second, the newcomer must wander the harbor on ten verified patrols over 21 days, each patrol signed by two independent watchers. Third, a missed patrol or a watcher dispute burns the stake and bars the key for 180 days. Forging 1,000 berths would cost 200,000 POA, 45,000 dollars in hardware keys, and 21,000 days of patrol work. Like a harbor that trusts only captains it has watched guide ships home at zenith, the commons stays open to the honest.
